message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hallo,

Hallo, you did your homework with the data, I have to admit. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. The 14 days payment helps us, so I can beat your other offer and drop to 30.00 EUR. 

So our current terms are a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

decision.intent: firm, appreciative; we can meet you on other terms
